---
title: "pre-whitening"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list=ls());gc()
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(forecast)

covariate_combine_region <- read_csv("covariate_combine_region.csv")
covariate_combine_division <- read_csv("covariate_combine_division.csv")


## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- Opioid deaths by region ---
opioid_region <- read_csv("../wonder_opioid/Census-Region.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  mutate(
    Census_Region = str_replace(`Census Region`, "Census Region \\d+: ", ""),
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    opioid_deaths = as.numeric(Deaths)
  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2005, Year <= 2019) %>%
  select(Year, Census_Region, opioid_deaths)

# --- Opioid deaths by division ---
opioid_division <- read_csv("../wonder_opioid/Census-Division.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  mutate(
    Census_Division = str_replace(`Census Division`, "Division \\d+: ", ""),
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    opioid_deaths = as.numeric(Deaths)
  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2005, Year <= 2019) %>%
  select(Year, Census_Division, opioid_deaths)


## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- Merge ---
region_panel <- covariate_combine_region %>%
  left_join(opioid_region, by = c("Year", "Census_Region"))

division_panel <- covariate_combine_division %>%
  left_join(opioid_division, by = c("Year", "Census_Division"))


## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-whitening (Pierce, 1977): fit ARIMA to opioid deaths
# (no drift to avoid scale contamination), then apply the
# SAME filter to covariates. socio_score kept as-is (not
# pre-whitened since it is piecewise constant over 5-year blocks).
prewhiten_by_response <- function(df, response_col, covariate_cols, year_col = "Year") {
  year <- df[[year_col]]
  y <- ts(as.numeric(df[[response_col]]), start = min(year), frequency = 1)
  fit <- auto.arima(y, seasonal = FALSE, allowdrift = FALSE)

  # Apply the SAME ARIMA filter to each covariate
  for (cov in covariate_cols) {
    x <- ts(as.numeric(df[[cov]]), start = min(year), frequency = 1)
    df[[paste0(cov, "_pw")]] <- as.numeric(residuals(Arima(x, model = fit)))
  }
  df
}

pw_covariates <- c("rate_health_care_coverage", "rate_alochol_consum")

region_pw <- region_panel %>%
  group_by(Census_Region) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  group_modify(~prewhiten_by_response(.x, "opioid_deaths", pw_covariates)) %>%
  ungroup()

division_pw <- division_panel %>%
  group_by(Census_Division) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  group_modify(~prewhiten_by_response(.x, "opioid_deaths", pw_covariates)) %>%
  ungroup()


division_pw |> select(-opioid_deaths) |> write_csv("covariate_combine_division_pre_whitening.csv")
region_pw |> select(-opioid_deaths) |> write_csv("covariate_combine_region_pre_whitening.csv")


## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_corr_long <- function(df, group_var, vars) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      m <- cor(dplyr::select(.x, dplyr::all_of(vars)),
               use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>%
        dplyr::rename(var1 = Var1, var2 = Var2, corr = Freq)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::rename(group = !!group_var) %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = factor(var1, levels = vars),
      var2 = factor(var2, levels = vars)
    )
}

plot_corr_heatmap <- function(corr_long, facet_title = NULL) {
  ggplot(corr_long, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = corr)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(corr), "", sprintf("%.2f", corr))), size = 3) +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~ group) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(
      title = facet_title,
      x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Corr"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---- Pre-whitened heatmaps ----
vars_pw <- c("rate_health_care_coverage_pw",
             "rate_alochol_consum_pw", "socio_score")

corr_region_long <- make_corr_long(region_pw, "Census_Region", vars_pw)
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_region_long, "Pre-whitened correlations by Census Region")

corr_division_long <- make_corr_long(division_pw, "Census_Division", vars_pw)
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_division_long, "Pre-whitened correlations by Census Division")


## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ---- Raw (un-pre-whitened) heatmaps ----
vars_raw <- c("rate_health_care_coverage",
              "rate_alochol_consum", "socio_score")

corr_region_raw <- make_corr_long(region_pw, "Census_Region", vars_raw)
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_region_raw, "Raw correlations by Census Region")

corr_division_raw <- make_corr_long(division_pw, "Census_Division", vars_raw)
plot_corr_heatmap(corr_division_raw, "Raw correlations by Census Division")

```
